title: Work view crashes with "Maximum update depth exceeded" in the row-window hook
outcome: Work view crashes with "Maximum update depth exceeded" in the row-window hook
acceptance: The Work view's table, tree and labels views render a project with more than WORK_WINDOW_ROWS rows without React's "Maximum update depth exceeded" error, including after scrolling to the end of the list and after the viewport is resized.
A regression test reproduces the update loop on the pre-fix code (a recorded RED) and passes on the fixed code (a host-recorded passing check).
The existing Work panel and use-work-window tests stay green, and `npx tsc --noEmit` stays clean.

completion.summary: Fixed Work table/window feedback that exhausted React update depth. Stable column allocation and visible-row projection preserve measured anchors, threshold transitions and reveals across table/tree/labels. Recorded RED, repaired anchor regression, Chrome replay, independent Codex/Claude review and current five-stage full gate pass.
